name: Spiked Shifting
body:
Prerequisite(s): Bladeling, wild shape class feature

Benefit(s): When you use your wild shape class feature you retain the armor spikes from your spiked skin racial trait. The damage of the armor spikes scales with the size of the creature you shift into.

Special: If you have the Honorary Bladeling feat this applies to any armor spikes you wear.
